No Fixed Address

Their backs are a real part of the passing game — RBs see 25% of targets (vs ~18%), which props up the back's reception floor.

The Offensive Blueprint

They lean on tempo — a 18% no-huddle rate (league ~11%) that inflates snap counts and everyone's volume.

By the numbers it's a struggling unit — a 42% success rate (below the 44% average).

In the Red Zone

Inside the 20 they lean run-heavy, passing 49% of the time, funnelling touchdown equity to the lead back.

Defense — A Balanced Defense

Soft against opposing WR1s — 67 rec yds/game (vs ~58). A rec-yards target.

Soft against opposing WR2s — 42 rec yds/game (vs ~36). A rec-yards target.

They surrender 114 rushing and 250 passing yards per game (league ~120 / ~230). No dominant funnel — read it matchup by matchup.

They leak TE touchdowns (0.39/game vs ~0.24) — an anytime-TD spot to attack.

The Betting Angles

Bottom line: opposing TE anytime-TD is a repeatable angle.

Built on 2024–25 data; the profile rebuilds through the season as the current staff and roster set their own tendencies.
